zh: 一个子数组要满足“类型互不相同”，长度不能超过 m；对每个长度 ℓ≤m，长度为 ℓ 的窗口有 n−ℓ+1 个，每个窗口至多贡献一个合格子数组，这给出了答案的上界。
如果序列中任意长度不超过 m 的窗口都互不相同，就能达到这个上界。按 1,2,…,m 循环排列正好满足：任意连续 m 个位置恰好是 m 种不同类型。
要在达到上界的同时字典序最小，每个位置都应选不在前 m−1 个位置中出现过的最小类型，这正好得到 1,2,…,m,1,2,… 的循环；直接输出第 i 个位置（从 0 开始）为 i mod m + 1，共 n 个数，用空格分隔。
en: A subarray whose types are all distinct cannot be longer than m; for each length l <= m there are n - l + 1 windows of that length, and each window contributes at most one qualifying subarray, which bounds the answer from above.

If every window of length at most m in the sequence has distinct types, the bound is reached. Cycling through 1, 2, ..., m does exactly that: any m consecutive positions contain all m different types.

To reach the bound and also be lexicographically smallest, each position should take the smallest type that does not appear among the previous m - 1 positions, which yields exactly the cycle 1, 2, ..., m, 1, 2, ...; print position i (0-based) as i mod m + 1, n numbers in total, separated by spaces.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Construct the sequence by cycling through 1,2,…,m.

## Proof of correctness

Each range of length at most m contributes at most one qualifying subarray, and a range longer than m cannot have all distinct types; the upper bound is Σ(n−ℓ+1) over ℓ=1..min(n,m). The cyclic sequence makes every window of length ≤m all distinct, reaching this bound. The lexicographically smallest construction must each time choose the smallest type that does not appear among the previous m−1 positions, so it is exactly the cycle 1,2,…,m.

## Complexity

Time O(n), auxiliary space O(1) (not counting the output).
